name: @ai-corporation/desktop
author: AI Corporation contributors
description: Electron desktop shell for AI Corporation.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.package: pnpm --workspace-root build:rust:release && pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:skill-runtime && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:dir: pnpm --workspace-root build:rust:release && pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:skill-runtime && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.start: pnpm --workspace-root build:rust && pnpm run prepare:skill-runtime && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --workspace-root build:rust && pnpm run prepare:skill-runtime && pnpm run build && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
